lines.text: Host a Christmas murder mystery for eight. The lights go out. The gold Star is gone. Every guest gets a character, a secret and an alibi. Nine clue cards. Three rounds. One fair answer, proven two ways. Sixteen pages. Instant download. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.

A Christmas escape room for the whole family. Solve four clues to open the Bell Vault. Two levels. Ages six to nine, and ten and up. No phone. No app. No internet. Forty-five minutes on the clock. Sixteen pages. Instant download. Tap the link, and grab it on Etsy.
